thread:
Aisha: seeing a bunch of alerts for `resp-time-99p` on several customer orgs since ~09:12 UTC, looks like flapping — spikes every minute for the last 40m :confused:
Aisha: dashboards show the 1m chart as mostly empty but the threshold chart keeps firing
Aisha: filing here before I escalate to eng - happened right after the metrics pipeline deploy at 09:10
Tom: thanks, tagging eng-sre. can you paste the alert rule and a sample datapoint?
Aisha: alert rule snippet:
```
name: resp-time-99p
expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, request_latency_ms[5m])
for: 2m
evaluation_interval: 1m
window_alignment: end
```
Aisha: sample points from the raw series (ingest_ts -> value):
```
2023-06-21T09:09:12Z -> 42
2023-06-21T09:10:03Z -> 120
2023-06-21T09:11:01Z -> 45
2023-06-21T09:12:05Z -> 110
```
Riley: hmm `window_alignment: end` + evaluation every 1m + our new rollup changed bucket origin by 30s (see rollout notes) — could be boundary misalignment creating alternating empty buckets
Lena: customers complaining about repeated noise, some have paging enabled. we should provide a mitigation ASAP
Tom: repro steps I ran:
1) query raw events and group by floor(ingest_ts, 1m) -> I see buckets at :03 and :33 seconds (not :00)
2) alerting engine aligns windows to :00/:30 depending on `window_alignment` which caused a mismatch with rollup buckets
Tom: immediate mitigation: set `evaluation_interval` to 30s and `for` to 3m OR change alert expr to use `timestamp(ingest_ts)` aligned to bucket origin. but that's a bandaid
Aisha: can we temporarily mute paging for impacted orgs? I can do that while you fix the rule
Tom: will do the mute. creating an internal ticket and assigning to eng-platform to revert rollup origin or make the alerting engine respect rollup offsets
Tom: ticket: PLAT-4789 (internal) — root cause suspected: rollup producer changed bucket origin during the deploy, leaving alerting aggregations misaligned
Riley: from platform side: we rolled a change that shifted rollup window origin to epoch+30s to optimize batching. that should have been opt-in. reverting now and adding a compatibility flag
alerts-bot: deployment detected for service=rollup-producer id=deploy-20270621-0910 by @riley
deploy-bot: canary passed -> rolling -> ETA full rollback ~10m
Tom: thanks. follow-up actions:
- rollup origin revert (Riley)
- make alert evaluation align to rollup offsets or optionally use `align_to_bucket("ingest_ts")` (Tom)
- run small smoke test with known customers (Aisha)
Lena: communication: can we notify impacted customers with an explanation + ETA? I'll draft a short message
Aisha: muted paging for orgs: acme-co, yellowtree, ionix (temporary) :white_check_mark:
Riley: rollback finished at 09:28 UTC, monitoring now. rolling back removed the :30s offset and buckets are back to :00 aligned
Tom: verified alert engine now sees continuous non-empty windows, no more minute-by-minute flapping in my test
Aisha: customer complaints dropped after mute + rollback, will keep open until 09:40 to confirm stability
Lena: thanks all. postmortem please include: why rollup origin change landed without opt-in, lack of test covering alert alignment, and a runbook for muting pages
Tom: agreed — I'll own the follow-up ticket to add an alerting alignment test and a flag to respect rollup offsets. closing this thread when postmortem is filed
Aisha: noted. closing once PM postmortem is in docs. :thumbsup:
